default.description: The GUI's entire Tauri surface is the protocol: one invoke (the app's `tau_command`, allowed by default for app-registered commands) and a listener for the coalesced `tau://event` stream — nothing else needs a core permission. The pilot/wdio permissions live in the separate e2e capability, generated only for `--features e2e` builds (sweep finding X1).

e2e.description: E2E/dogfooding permissions (sweep finding X1): the pilot + WebdriverIO plugins, compiled in and registered only in `--features e2e` debug builds. Generated by build.rs; do not edit.
